notes.title: Our First Major Update is Live
notes.notes:
Namaste!
New season is just round the corner, and we have prepared an exciting update to all of our meditators. Our meditation game now features some major changes requested by our players:

[b]THE WEATHER CONTROL[/b]
Click the number [6] to cycle between all the weathers our meditation experience offers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/7ef1a8d969c544a57a6051468fdaca031d8cb9c8.jpg[/img]

[b]HIGHLY REQUESTED SETTINGS[/b]
You can now adjust the mouse sensitivity, enable/disable the rectile dot cursor and adjust the gamma settings. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/b0979fa1da46939e0fe5fa9a9e1b755654649f13.jpg[/img]

You can still influence the next updates by participating in our form here:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1hD5Edu95rspUBMum0O7MG3_ECayaU5tfEbXv-rE4Pj0/viewform?edit_requested=true]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1hD5Edu95rspUBMum0O7MG3_ECayaU5tfEbXv-rE4Pj0/viewform?edit_requested=true[/url]

Also we fixed lots of bugs found by the users on the Steam Community. Go and check them out now!
The demo is available again so you can try before you buy!

Just stay mindful,
ASMR Game Labs

notes.title: Major Update coming!
notes.notes:
Dear Meditators,
We're happy to announce that we will be rolling out a major update in the beginning of September. We want to fix errors our community suggested in the Steam Groups and add a new, mostly requested feature:

[b]CONTROLING WEATHER.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/ba18a9b83a0535751b92ecdaa37834cfafd0531a.jpg[/img]

You activate it by entering into the stone (global key E now) and pressing "6".
This allows you to change instantly from a clear conditions to rainy, foggy or snowy mood.

Just be mindful,
ASMR Game Labs

notes.title: VERSION 1.0: Alan Watts - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Namaste,
It is finally here. It is our most ambitious update ever. It is our BIGGEST update ever. The forest is bigger than ever, new biomes, new sounds, foliage and so much more. It is the culmination of more than two years of development and the Mindfulness grand finale. It is The Full Release, and it is ready to be played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/7e2ce87e9a4bb126ab8e2c6940f49b66d1b95849.jpg[/img]

Before we get into the details of this massive release, we would like to thank you all for joining us on this journey. It has been amazing to see so many people play and appreciate Mindfulness Simulator and without you we would have never made it here. With this update, we are happy to announce that we are leaving Playtests, as we consider Mindfulness Simulator to no longer be in need of that title. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/7d2cf4bb64c07cee040f47001bcf96d9bba6301a.jpg[/img]

We have looked forward to this day for many months and at this point we just cannot wait to see all the Let’s Plays, streams and to simply hear what you think of it! So let us not waste any more time and dive straight into it!

Just be mindful,
ASMR Game Labs

notes.title: Mindfulness Major Updates
notes.notes:
Namaste,
We have been listening to the feedback you have been sending us during the playtests and Steam Next Fest and prepared a list of fixed to the game and demo just before the official release:

- The voice is no longer muffled on some devices
- The game is now optimized
- The stone rolling on the grass has now much more pleasent sound
- Wolves were distributed less probable in the forest (i.e. finding one will be a challange now)
- Rabbits going upside-down are fixed
- Be quiet button now works as expected
- A bug with a stone moving without being inside is fixed.

We hope you will find this update much more mindful and calming.

Stay mindful.
~ASMR Game Labs

notes.title: WOLVES
notes.notes:
Fellow Meditators,
Wolves are just a tiny part of our forest ecosystem. They wander through depths of our green space and are actually friendly. They won't be eating rabbits or doing any predator things, because... they don't have to. The land is friendly to any existence, be it the physical body or just the ego of the player. 

They howl from time to time to add to the ambiance of the place though. You can walk close and look at them and see how they live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/c7205892c66466ec7d1a760a067628ac8601bcf2.jpg[/img] 

P.S. Don't forget to add us to your wishlists and tell your friends about our unique project.

Just be mindful.
~ASMR Game Labs

notes.notes:

If you love to listen to ASMR sounds on Youtube or Twitch, then this is going to be something that contributes to your overall peacefulness.

notes.title: What can you do as a stone?
notes.notes:
Fellow Meditators,
Today we wanted to highlight a very important part of our experience - what can you do when you are a stone? As you know you may control your own ego or enter a stone and see a world from its perspective. It's a very different experience.

So here's what you can do when you enter a stone:
[list]
[*] go back to your ego
[*] listen to Alan Watts' wisdoms
[*] roll on the ASMR grass
[*] fly through the forest
[*] join wind in the breathing session
[*] travel in time
[*] travel in space
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/a72b2c3673ceebe979378201beca901db0628a75.jpg[/img]

We will be posting what each of these actions mean in the separate posts soon!

Just be mindful.
~ASMR Game Labs

notes.title: SIGN UP for the demo PLAYTESTS!
notes.notes:
Namaste,
We have some exciting news for you today!
You can sign up for the playtests of the demo of Mindfulness Simulator: ASMR Meditation Game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/dfa99a93aa062a23e1bd6a656453cdfaa9ac0f62.png[/img]

[b]How can you get access to the playtests?[/b]

It's very easy. You just need to go to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1916690/Mindfulness_Simulator__ASMR_Meditation_Game/]store page[/url] and click on the 'Request access' button. It couldn't be easier!

[b]When will you be notified about the start of the playtests?[/b]

Once the registration is closed, you will get an email with an invitation to the playtests. Check it regularly! We can say that you will be able to play... next month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/5bc31b68277cfff9bc11e36df1892bce55509423.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The 1st day of Spring
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034749/7d2cf4bb64c07cee040f47001bcf96d9bba6301a.jpg[/img]

Namaste,
Every year, the cold of winter melts away and spring brings a new beginning. New beginnings are never easy, but we have some uplifting quotes that will inspire you to embrace them.

"If we had no winter, the spring would not be so pleasant." ~Anne Bradstreet
"If you look the right way, you can see that the whole world is a garden." ~Frances Hodgson Burnett
"Seasons change, and so do we." ~Nikki Che

And here are some updates about our game! We are currently working on:
- implementing the [b]Settings screen[/b] so that game works on most of the PCs
- implementing [b]language support[/b]
- fixing the bugs

We hope you are as excited as we and a couple thousands of wishlisted users!

Yours,
ASMR Game Lab
